title: Program Manager (Fintech, Payments and Digital Banking)
description: Top 3 Reasons To Join Us International fintech & digital banking firm Top salary, bonus & stock options Work & travel globally with innovation teams The Job Location: Hanoi, Vietnam Department: Technology and Delivery Employment type: Full time, permanent Reports to: Executive Management Role split: Approximately 70 percent technical delivery and team leadership, 30 percent business development About Vietpay Tiger Financial is a Canadian public company that owns and operates fintech businesses and digital banks focused on Vietnam, Malaysia, Hong Kong, Indonesia, Thailand, the Philippines, Cambodia, and Myanmar. Vietpay, a Vietnamese subsidiary of Tiger Financial, delivers digital payment and banking solutions across Vietnam and Southeast Asia. Our platform spans Smart POS, merchant acquiring, card issuing, payment gateways, QR payments, SoftPOS, banking integrations, and cloud-based payment infrastructure. We work with banks, payment schemes, merchants, and technology partners to build secure, scalable payment solutions. As our acquiring and issuing business expands, we seek a Program Manager to lead delivery and support commercial growth. Role Overview: Technical Delivery and Business Development Lead technical delivery for major bank and enterprise partners, including our main bank partner. Guide a cross-functional team through integrations and customization, owning delivery plans and partner communication while architects and engineers handle design and development. Also support business development in line with Vietpay’s growth strategy. The priority is technical delivery and practical payments expertise. Bring a working understanding of fintech, digital banking, and card issuing or acquiring, alongside confidence in commercial discussions. You should be comfortable in architecture reviews, bank certification calls, delivery meetings, and commercial discussions. Key Responsibilities Primary Mandate: Manage Bank & Enterprise Partnership, System Integration, Technical Delivery & Customization Own technical delivery for projects with Vietpay’s main bank partner, from kickoff through production deployment and post-launch support. Lead the coordination of API integration, financial messaging, and connectivity between Vietpay and partner banks. Plan and coordinate bank and payment scheme certification activities with Visa, Mastercard, NAPAS, JCB, UnionPay, and other partners, as required. Coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT), production rollout, cutover, and launch support with internal teams and the bank’s technical teams. Manage day-to-day partner relationships, maintain delivery momentum, and align expectations. Customer and Stakeholder Management Serve as the primary point of contact between customers, partners, and Vietpay’s internal technical teams. Lead requirements workshops with banks and enterprise customers, translating business needs into clear technical requirements and agreed deliverables. Manage stakeholder expectations throughout the project lifecycle, from scoping through production deployment. Facilitate technical discussions between customers and engineering teams, keeping decisions aligned with delivery priorities. Maintain customer satisfaction during implementation and post-launch support. Technical Team Leadership and Delivery Lead, mentor, and line manage a cross-functional team across engineering, QA, integration, DevOps, and certification. Own delivery from planning through launch across acquiring, issuing, switching, Smart POS, SoftPOS, QR payments, and payment gateways. Translate commercial and product requirements into clear technical scope, delivery plans, and realistic timelines, agreeing architecture decisions with technical specialists. Establish and uphold delivery standards with technical leads across code quality, documentation, testing, release management, and operational readiness. Manage scope, schedules, budgets, resources, dependencies, and risks across concurrent projects. Work with architects and developers on solution design and integration approaches, including REST APIs, microservices, EMV, and ISO 8583 messaging. Drive the resolution of technical blockers, make timely delivery decisions, and escalate issues with clear recommendations. Establish consistent delivery governance through milestone tracking, status reports, risk registers, and structured stakeholder communication. Secondary Mandate: Business Development and Growth Develop new opportunities and expand relationships with banks, financial institutions, merchants, aggregators, and strategic partners in line with growth targets. Build and maintain lasting relationships across the acquiring and payments ecosystem. Identify opportunities for Smart POS, SoftPOS, QR payments, payment gateways, and issuing solutions. Prepare proposals, RFP and RFI responses, presentations, and solution demonstrations with technical teams. Support contract negotiations and commercial discussions, and represent Vietpay in customer meetings, workshops, and industry events. Your Skills and Experience Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. A strong technical foundation is essential; a business qualification is an advantage. 7 to 12 years of experience in banking, fintech, payment processing, payment gateways, acquiring, issuing, or digital payments. A proven record of leading enterprise payments or banking software implementations from planning through production deployment. Experience leading or coordinating technical teams across engineering, QA, and integration. Direct experience working with banks, payment service providers, or payment schemes on integration and certification. Strong commercial awareness, supported by experience in technical presales or business development within financial technology. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage technical and business audiences. Technical Knowledge Bring practical knowledge of the areas below, with depth in payment systems and integration taking priority over expertise in every technology or product. Category What the candidate should know Payment systems Merchant acquiring, card issuing, EMV, ISO 8583, payment switching, settlement, reconciliation, chargebacks, refunds, and the full transaction lifecycle. POS and acceptance Smart POS, SoftPOS, QR payments, payment gateways, and mobile payment technologies, with a basic understanding of Android POS solutions. Banking and operations Merchant onboarding and management systems, payment operations, banking integrations, financial messaging, and card center operations or card management platforms. Software and architecture REST APIs, microservices architecture, API integration, SQL databases, and cloud platforms, with AWS preferred. Delivery and project management Agile and Scrum, Waterfall, risk management, resource planning, budget tracking, vendor management, and change management. Preferred Qualifications Practical experience implementing acquiring or issuing platforms. Experience working with Visa, Mastercard, NAPAS, JCB, UnionPay, or other international and domestic payment schemes. Familiarity with PCI DSS and payment security standards. PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum Master, or an equivalent project management certification. Working proficiency in English and Vietnamese. Leadership and Soft Skills Strong technical leadership and the credibility to guide engineers and architects. Clear decision-making and sound judgment under pressure and in ambiguous situations. Excellent negotiation, presentation, and written communication skills. Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and competing priorities while maintaining delivery focus. A customer-focused approach balanced with commercial discipline. Structured, analytical problem-solving, with clear ownership and consistent follow-through. What Success Looks Like Within the first 6 months A thorough understanding of Vietpay’s products, integration architecture, and main bank partner delivery roadmap. Established delivery governance, including a clear project pipeline, milestone tracking, and regular risk and status reporting. Delivery of at least one priority integration or certification milestone on time and to the agreed standard. Within the first 12 months A strong technical delivery team with consistent standards and measurable improvements in delivery quality and predictability. Key bank partner projects launched into production, supported by strong working relationships across both organizations. A measurable contribution to the commercial pipeline through technical presales and partner opportunities aligned with growth targets. Why You'll Love Working Here Why Join Vietpay Join an international public company offering stock options and opportunities for international travel and professional growth. Work across payment and digital banking technologies, including acquiring, issuing, Smart POS, QR payments, and cloud-based payment platforms. Lead delivery relationships with major banks and payments ecosystem partners in Vietnam. Contribute to strategic fintech initiatives across Southeast Asia. Competitive salary with performance-based incentives. Develop your career within a payment technology business focused on growth in Southeast Asia. To apply, please submit your CV and a short summary of relevant Java, microservices, and system migration experience, including examples of live systems you have re architected.

Phân tích bài toán và thiết kế giải pháp GenAI Làm việc với các đơn vị nghiệp vụ để tiếp nhận yêu cầu, đánh giá khả năng ứng dụng GenAI và đề xuất hướng tiếp cận kỹ thuật phù hợp. Phân tích bối cảnh sử dụng, dữ liệu đầu vào/đầu ra và rủi ro để thiết kế kiến trúc GenAI khả thi, an toàn. Lựa chọn mô hình, nền tảng và phương thức triển khai (on-premise, private cloud, hybrid, API service) phù hợp với từng bài toán. 2. Phát triển và triển khai các dịch vụ GenAI Thiết kế và triển khai giải pháp GenAI trên nền tảng mô hình mã nguồn mở hoặc dịch vụ API bên ngoài (ví dụ: OpenAI, Gemini hoặc tương đương), tuân thủ chính sách bảo mật và quản trị rủi ro của Ngân hàng. Đóng gói ứng dụng GenAI thành dịch vụ (API/microservice) để tích hợp với hệ thống nghiệp vụ, cổng nội bộ và nền tảng số. 3. Phát triển giải pháp RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) Thiết kế và triển khai pipeline RAG, bao gồm thu thập, tiền xử lý, indexing và truy xuất tri thức từ dữ liệu nội bộ. Kết hợp LLM với semantic search/vector database nhằm đảm bảo phản hồi đúng ngữ cảnh, bám sát dữ liệu nội bộ và hạn chế hallucination. Phối hợp với Data Governance và BI để đảm bảo dữ liệu sử dụng cho RAG được phân loại, cấp quyền và kiểm soát theo quy định. 4. Phát triển AI Agent và tự động hóa thông minh Thiết kế và triển khai AI Agent/Agentic Workflow thực hiện chuỗi tác vụ từ tiếp nhận yêu cầu, truy xuất, phân tích, phản hồi đến thực hiện hành động. Tích hợp GenAI với các công cụ workflow automation (ví dụ: n8n hoặc nền tảng tương đương) nhằm tự động hóa quy trình nội bộ và hỗ trợ các tác vụ lặp lại. Chuẩn hóa Agent và Workflow để tái sử dụng, mở rộng và triển khai trong toàn Ngân hàng. 5. Giám sát, kiểm soát và cải tiến ứng dụng GenAI Thiết lập monitoring, logging và đánh giá chất lượng ứng dụng GenAI về độ chính xác, mức độ phù hợp ngữ cảnh, hallucination, hiệu năng và độ trễ. Theo dõi chi phí sử dụng mô hình, tài nguyên hệ thống và tối ưu hiệu năng, chi phí vận hành. Cải tiến prompt, pipeline và logic Agent khi dữ liệu hoặc yêu cầu nghiệp vụ thay đổi. Đảm bảo ứng dụng GenAI đáp ứng yêu cầu về bảo mật, phân quyền và kiểm soát dữ liệu đầu vào/đầu ra. 6. description: Top 3 Reasons To Join Us Hybrid working; Flexible time; Macbook Pro L&D programs; 17 days off 13.7 million B2C users; 140,000+ business customer The Job This role expects a strong security mindset, with a clear understanding of data privacy, credential protection, device security, and the responsible use of corporate systems, tools, and accounts. RESPONSIBILITIES Lead the QA Team & Define the QA / AI QA Strategy Build, hire, and grow a QA/SDET team in Vietnam, and foster a strong quality culture across engineering. Define and drive the department's QA strategy with AI at its core, aligned with company-wide quality initiatives led by the CQO, and set standard processes for testing, defect management, and release decisions. Partner with Engineering, Product, and DevOps to shift quality left, and act as the quality owner in planning and release discussions. Lead AI QA Initiatives & Develop AI QA Tools Lead AI adoption in QA: evaluate AI/LLM tools and drive AI-driven practices such as test generation, self-healing tests, bug triaging, root cause analysis, and synthetic test data. Design and build in-house AI QA tools and agents (e.g., reusable AI skills/workflows) that fit into the team's daily testing and CI/CD pipelines. Set up a framework and metrics to measure the impact of AI in QA (e.g., time saved, test coverage, defect detection rate, AI output accuracy, adoption rate), and use the data to keep improving. Automation Architecture & Quality Engineering Architect a scalable, reliable test automation infrastructure, including non-functional testing (performance, load, API security), and enforce coding standards through code reviews. Stay hands-on as the technical lead for SDETs: write and review automation code, set the framework design and best practices, and coach engineers on software engineering skills in testing. Own test pipeline health in CI/CD: optimize execution speed (parallelization, test selection), reduce flaky tests, and manage test environments and test data for reliable, fast feedback. Your Skills and Experience REQUIREMENTS Must-have 7+ years in QA, including 3+ years leading a QA team of 5+ members, with proven ownership of QA strategy and release decisions. Hands-on experience building scalable test automation frameworks (Web, Mobile, or API) with tools like Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or Appium, and integrating them into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins). Proven experience leading AI adoption in testing: applying GenAI/LLM tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT) and building AI-powered QA tools or workflows (prompt engineering, AI agents, LLM API integration). Data-driven mindset: experience defining quality and AI effectiveness metrics, and communicating insights to stakeholders. Strong proficiency in at least one programming language (TypeScript, Java, Python, or C#) and a solid understanding of system architecture to assess quality risks. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Business-level English and excellent communication skills, comfortable working with teams in Japan and Vietnam. Nice-to-have AI evaluation skills: experience evaluating LLM/AI output quality (e.g., building eval datasets, LLM-as-a-judge, eval frameworks like Promptfoo, DeepEval, or Ragas) and testing AI-powered products for accuracy, hallucination, and safety. Experience with test management and observability tools (e.g., TestRail, Zephyr Scale, Grafana, Datadog). title: Senior QA Manager (QA/QC, Tester, English)
description: Top 3 Reasons To Join Us Flexible working hour Private health care insurance Premium annual health care check The Job You lead our QA lead layer. Five team leads and our QA Architect, around 25 engineers, twelve product lines plus the automation and performance functions. You are accountable for QA delivery and performance across all of it: targets, staffing, developing your leads, and how QA works day to day. That means defect lifecycle, test execution, triage, estimation, review discipline and reporting. This is not a hands-on testing role and it is not a team lead role with a bigger title. You will be judged on what six people and their teams produce, not on what you personally test. Expect under 10% hands-on. Enough to keep technical credibility with your leads, not enough to do their jobs. ● Own QA delivery and performance across twelve product lines and the automation and performance functions. ● Develop five team leads: goals, one to ones, performance decisions, hiring. Two of them will be new hires you inherit inside their first months. ● Own your teams' targets against the organisation's QA scorecard. Set them, review them per team, hit them. Quality outcomes, not case counts. ● Own how QA works day to day inside the release train model: defect lifecycle, test execution, triage, estimation and self estimation, review discipline, reporting. Argue for changes to the model itself. The VP owns it. ● Build specification review and estimation capability in your leads until area level scoping no longer routes through the VP. ● Raise automation share and throughput per engineer. Make testing cycles faster without sacrificing coverage or confidence. ● Own QA's side of escaped defect analysis. Every customer escape ends in a change to what QA does. Partner with Support on recurring and high impact issues and feed the patterns back across all teams. ● Work with Product and Development to review requirements through a customer impact lens. Improve defect prevention, not just detection. ● Prepare the quarterly business review and co-present your teams' numbers with the VP, who owns the QA story told to the executive team. ● Prepare the quality evidence the VP needs for release go or no-go. You do not make the ship call. Your Skills and Experience Required Qualifications: ● 8 or more years in software quality assurance, including 3 or more years managing managers or team leads , not only engineers, in a software product organisation. ● A track record of raising a QA organisation's output, with numbers . Throughput per engineer, automation share, reduction in escaped defects, cycle time. And experience building QA processes where none existed. ● An automation first delivery flow , and the ability to drive test volume up rather than reduce it. Our scale is roughly 1,000 test cases per feature, about 3,900 cases in the quarterly release train scope, and the largest single product line is about 1,650. Tell us how you would produce and manage that, for example AI assisted generation, templates, parallel execution, risk prioritisation. ● QA side ownership of escaped defects . When a defect reaches a customer, you change what QA does, not only what Product and Development do. ● English strong enough to hold your own in front of our CEO . You will co-present the quarterly business review and negotiate with Product and Development leadership. ● AI in your daily work (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Cursor, Atlassian Rovo or similar). You can explain where it sits in your workflow, what you review before trusting it, and what you tried that did not work. This is not optional here. ● Comfortable being accountable for other people's teams . Hiring, performance decisions and hard calls, including managing a senior technical specialist who knows the product better than you do. Desired Qualifications: ● Enterprise or on premises software shipped into environments you cannot touch after release. We ship to more than 30,000 customer environments, so a bad build cannot be fixed overnight. ● Experience working closely with Support or Customer Success on analysis of escaped defects. ● Cloud storage platforms such as AWS S3, Wasabi or Azure, and hypervisors such as VMware, Hyper-V, Proxmox or Nutanix. ● Test management at scale, Xray or similar. Why You'll Love Working Here The Nakivo team in Vietnam has been changing very fast in the recent years, we have grown from a group of 6 engineers to the current team size of 80 and we are expecting to grow even more in the next following years. title: Chief Enterprise Architect (CEA)
description: Top 3 Reasons To Join Us The Job ITviec's client is looking for a Chief Enterprise Architect (CEA) who defines, owns and governs enterprise architecture — the business, data, application and technology architecture of the bank 1 Enterprise Architecture Vision, Strategy & Roadmap Define and own the enterprise architecture vision, architecture principles and target-state architecture across the business, data, application and technology domains, aligned to the Banking IT Strategy and the Data & AI Strategy. Translate business strategy into baseline, target and transition architectures and a sequenced architecture roadmap that the delivery organization can execute. 2 Capability-to-Platform Boundaries Starting from the capability baseline approved by the strategy and transformation function, decide how each business capability is served — by an enterprise business platform, a shared enterprise service, the integration layer or a channel application — so that business rules, workflow and state are held once and are not re-implemented channel by channel. 3 Platform, Application & Integration Architecture Set architecture standards for enterprise platforms, digital channels, core banking and business systems; ensure consistency, interoperability and reuse across technology domains. Direct the progressive modernization of the legacy core and surrounding systems, minimizing migration and operational risk in a brownfield estate. 4 Cloud, Infrastructure & Resilience Architecture Define the hybrid-cloud architecture strategy (on-premises, AWS, Microsoft 365) within data-residency and SBV constraints; direct cloud-native adoption and application modernization. 5 Data, AI & Emerging-Technology Architecture Partner with the CDO so that the enterprise data architecture (Lake House, Data Mesh, data integration) and AI platforms are coherent with the enterprise architecture; govern the integration architecture of the enterprise data ecosystem. 6 Architecture Governance, Decision Authority & Technical Debt Chair the Architecture Board and run architecture governance over solution designs, integration patterns, data-architecture alignment, security and resilience controls, technology standards, exceptions and architecture decisions. Ensure architectures comply with security, privacy and regulatory requirements, together with the CISO and DPO 7 EA Practice & Repository Build and maintain the EA practice: the EA method, repository and metamodel; current, target and transition architectures; the application and integration inventory; architecture decision records; the exception log and the architecture debt register. 8 Organization, Executive Leadership & Architecture Capability Lead the Architecture & Portfolio Governance Center: plan, assign and develop the Enterprise Architecture and Solution Architecture teams and raise the professional standard of both. Advise the CEO, Board of Management and Board of Directors on technology strategy and architecture investment; represent architecture in Board and Executive Committee discussions. Mentor the bank's enterprise, application, data, infrastructure and security architects and technical leaders; build an architecture community of practice across IT and business. Your Skills and Experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field. 15+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, enterprise architecture or technology leadership, including 5+ years in a senior, principal or chief architect role (or equivalent) at an enterprise-scale organization. Proven leadership of enterprise architecture — not only solution architecture — in a large, complex, regulated organization, ideally a bank, with accountability for the architecture of the whole enterprise. Demonstrated brownfield modernization through a large-scale digital transformation, with evidence of sequencing change safely and delivering measurable outcomes. Has established and run architecture governance (an architecture board, compliance reviews, technical-debt management) that measurably improved architecture quality and conformance. Why You'll Love Working Here Attractive compensation package (with bi-annual performance and salary reviews). Opportunity to participate in large-scale tech projects and key digital transformation initiatives of the Bank. Hands-on experience with cutting-edge architectures and technologies, working directly with global leading partners (AWS, IBM, Temenos, BCG). Dynamic environment with clear career advancement opportunities and a distinct corporate culture. Premium comprehensive health insurance package.

title: Technical Lead (Java)
description: Top 3 Reasons To Join Us The Job Role Summary We are looking for experienced and forward‑thinking Technical Leads – Backend to lead the design and development of backend services for large‑scale digital banking and financial platforms. The role requires strong expertise in system architecture and design, microservices backend engineering, and understanding of banking / financial service domains, along with the ability to lead engineering teams and communicate confidently with client stakeholders to deliver scalable, secure and high-quality backend solutions. In today’s engineering ecosystem, AI assistants are integral to the Software Development Lifecycle. Engineers, including this role, are expected to leverage AI tools for code generation, test creation, and refactoring, while focusing their expertise on architecture, system thinking, code verification, security, quality assurance, and strategic technical decisions. Key Responsibilities Technical Leadership Lead and mentor a team of backend engineers across multiple functional domains. Provide technical direction and ensure alignment with architecture standards and engineering best practices. Review solution designs, code quality, and implementation approaches — promoting clean architecture, resilient microservices, and AI‑enhanced development patterns. Guide the team in diagnosing complex technical challenges, using both traditional analysis and AI-powered debugging or observability tools. Support planning, estimation, and technical decision-making within the engineering team. Backend Architecture & Development Design and develop backend services using Java and modern backend frameworks (e.g., Spring Boot). Define and implement microservices-based architecture and API-driven systems. Ensure backend services are scalable, secure, resilient, and maintainable. Drive best practices in backend development, including maintainable system design, automated testing, code quality, API governance, performance optimization and documentation. Work closely with DevOps teams to support CI/CD pipelines, incorporate intelligent automation, and ensure stable, secure deployment environments. Integrate AI-assisted development practices into coding, testing, documentation, code reviews, and defect prevention workflows. Banking & Payment Domain Design backend systems supporting banking products and financial transaction processing. Build and maintain services related to payments, card processing, financial operations, and core banking functions. Ensure backend implementations comply with financial industry standards and security requirements. Collaborate with business and product teams to translate banking and financial requirements into technical solutions. Client Collaboration & Delivery Work directly with client stakeholders, architects, and product owners to understand business processes, requirements and define technical solutions. Challenge and clarify requirements with curiosity dig deep into the "why" behind business needs. Participate in architecture discussions and technical workshops with client teams. Communicate technical designs, trade-offs, and solutions clearly to both engineering teams and non-technical stakeholders. Support project delivery by ensuring technical risks are identified and mitigated early. Your Skills and Experience Technical Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field 8+ years of backend development experience. 3+ years in a Technical Lead or senior engineering role. Strong experience with Java and backend frameworks (e.g. Spring Boot). Experience designing and implementing microservices, API-driven systems, event-driven architectures or messaging systems (e.g., Kafka), RDBMS and SQL. Solid experience working with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). Strong understanding of CI/CD, version control (Git), and automated pipelines. Experience working in Agile delivery environments. Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Specific Qualifications Experience working in banking, fintech, or financial services environments. Fluent English communication. Familiarity with core banking, card, payment systems, or related financial systems. Knowledge of industry standards (e.g. PCI-DSS) or payment security practices. Handson exposure to AIassisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar). Ability to write effective prompts and context for AI code generation. Ability to assess AI-generated code, verify security vulnerabilities, validate AI-generated tests for completeness and edge case coverage. Nice-to-Have Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) Familiarity with modern API architectures such as GraphQL or BFF patterns Experience working with mobile-first platforms or digital banking applications What Makes You Successful in This Role You are experienced engineer with great mindset in leading end-to-end technical delivery and problem solving, forward thinking in applying AI-assisted solutions to optimize productivity, and willingness in mentoring others. Why You'll Love Working Here Our client is a prominent European-based technology consultancy with over 30 years of global expertise in digital transformation. They specialize in engineering next-generation core systems and high-scale data solutions for industry leaders within the Financial Services, Insurance, and Manufacturing sectors. Operating a robust network across more than 20 countries, the firm is at the forefront of integrating advanced automation and modern engineering workflows into the software development lifecycle. With a strong commitment to technical excellence and a distributed global delivery model, they offer senior experts the chance to lead complex modernization initiatives. This is an ideal environment for those looking to influence the future of digital banking and large-scale enterprise architecture. Why You'll Love Working With Us Global Innovation Hub: Be part of a prestigious European technology firm with a 30-year legacy, working on large-scale digital transformation projects for top-tier global financial institutions. Cutting-Edge Tech Stack: Engage with an AI-centric environment where you are encouraged to leverage advanced AI-assisted development tools (like GitHub Copilot and Claude Code) to redefine engineering productivity. Expert Collaboration: Work alongside some of the industry's brightest minds in an international setting that fosters professional growth and cultural exchange. Continuous Upskilling: Access specialized training programs, including professional English courses and advanced certifications in Cloud, Architecture, and emerging technologies like Smart Contracts. Competitive & Transparent Rewards: Enjoy a robust compensation package featuring a guaranteed 13th-month salary, performance-based bonuses, and premium health insurance for your peace of mind. Work-Life Balance: Benefit from a flexible Hybrid working model and extensive annual leave, allowing you to balance professional excellence with personal well-being. High-Impact Projects: Direct your expertise toward modernizing next-generation core systems that power the daily lives of millions in the banking and fintech sectors.

title: Cyber Security Engineer (AppSec/PenTest)
description: Top 3 Reasons To Join Us Global growth with experienced engineers Innovative, balanced, creative culture Competitive salary, benefits, training The Job Scandinavian Software Park is the Hanoi-based tech hub and home to several of Scandinavia’s market-leading B2B SaaS companies. Founded and operated by Monterro, the leading B2B software investor in the Nordics, Scandinavian Software Park enables portfolio companies to accelerate growth and build high-end engineering and product capabilities in Vietnam. This role sits within our product services, aiming to delivering expert-level services directly to Monterro’s portfolio of 30+ B2B software companies. This is a senior individual contributor role for a seasoned security professional who brings deep offensive and defensive expertise and can operate independently across multiple complex engagements. As a Cyber Security Specialist, you will be a key technical authority, leading continuous vulnerability intelligence operations, conducting advanced penetration tests and code security reviews, and advising on the security of AI-powered features across Monterro’s portfolio of Nordic B2B SaaS products. You are also expected to bring the judgment and seniority to triage ambiguous findings, lead threat modeling sessions, support incident response and raise the security maturity of the products you work with. What you’ll do Penetration Testing Map the environment of each portfolio company, including LLMs, prompts, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, APIs and connected systems, to define a precise attack surface before testing begins. Plan and execute full-scope penetration tests against web applications, APIs, and internal systems for portfolio companies, from scoping and reconnaissance through to exploitation and reporting. Stress-test system behavior under real-world adversarial conditions, evaluating how models and agents respond to manipulation, privilege abuse, and unexpected inputs. Red Teaming Conduct threat intelligence-led OSINT reconnaissance to map each portfolio company’s digital footprint, identify exposed assets, and define realistic attack scenarios grounded in how real adversaries operate. Execute multi-vector attack simulations combining external and internal network exploitation, social engineering, phishing, and lateral movement to reveal how far an attacker could realistically penetrate. Run both Full Simulation engagements (end-to-end attack chain from initial access to exfiltration) and Assumed Compromise scenarios (focused on lateral movement and detection/response after access). Validate detection and response capabilities: evaluate whether security controls, monitoring, and incident response processes would catch and contain a real attack. Code-Based Security Review Lead in-depth security reviews of application codebases, identifying logic flaws, injection vulnerabilities, broken authentication, insecure data handling and supply-chain risks. Apply AI-assisted static analysis alongside manual review techniques to achieve deeper coverage across multiple languages and frameworks. Delivery findings with severity ratings, exploitability assessments and precise remediation guidance; present results directly to engineering leads and CTOs. Threat Modeling Lead threat modeling sessions (STRIDE, PASTA, or equivalent) with portfolio company product and engineering teams during design and architecture phases, not just after the fact. Translate threat models into actionable security requirements, test cases, and backlog items that engineering teams can act on. Build and maintain threat profiles for portfolio companies, updating them as products evolve and new attack surfaces emerge. System Security Assess the security of AI-powered product features – covering prompt injections, indirect prompt injection, model data leakage, insecure LLM integrations and adversarial input scenarios. Stay current on the evolving AI threat landscape (OWASP LLM Top 10, emerging jailbreak patterns, supply-chain risks in AI frameworks) and translate findings into practical guidance. Your Skills and Experience What we are looking for Requirements: 5+ years of hands-on experience in application security, penetration testing or vulnerability management. Solid experience conducting vulnerability assessments and penetration tests on web applications and APIs with the ability to deliver professional reports independently. Strong understanding of OWASP Top 10 and OWASP LLM Top 10, web and API vulnerability classes, authentication and authorization flaws and business logic abuse. Experience with red teaming that covers traditional adversarial operations (threat intelligence-led attack planning, OSINT reconnaissance, multi-vector simulations and detection/response validation) and AI-specific targets (LLM jailbreaks, prompt injection, and adversarial testing of generative AI features in production). Experience leading threat modeling sessions (STRIDE, PASTA, or equivalent) with engineering and product teams. Familiarity with AI/LLM security risks: prompt injection, model data leakage, insecure LLM integrations and adversarial scenarios. Strong code review skills across multiple languages (e.g., Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Go, C#) – able to identify vulnerabilities in unfamiliar codebases independently. Experience with AI-assisted or automated security tooling (e.g., Semgrep, Snyk, GitHub Advanced Security…) and the judgment to critically evaluate their output. Cloud penetration testing experience (AWS, Azure, GCP) and container/Kubernetes security. Understanding of B2B SaaS security patterns: multi-tenancy, OAuth/OIDC, API authentication and cloud-native privilege models. Strong English communication skills, both written and spoken. Nice to have OSCP, OSWoE, GPEN, GWAPT, or equivalent offensive security certification Experience with TIBER-EU or ART (Advanced Red Teaming) frameworks. Knowledge of compliance and risk frameworks relevant to Nordic/European software companies: ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, NIS2. Prior experience working with B2B SaaS or Nordic/European software companies is a strong plus Why this role is interesting You get to work at the actual intersection of AI and offensive security, not just reading about it, but testing it against real products in production. Full access to the best AI-assisted security tooling, no personal budget worries, no approval process, no waiting. You’ll work across 30+ different tech stacks and companies, not just one. You’ll see inside many different B2B software businesses through security reviews and threat modeling. Scandinavian work culture: trust, autonomy and a sensible view on work-life balance. Join our innovative and market-leading Scandinavian SaaS company and accelerate your growth alongside experienced software engineers from around the world. We value creativity, innovation, and work-life balance in our Scandinavian work culture, and offer a competitive salary with 100% official salary during the probation period, annual reviews, and 13th month salary. We prioritize the well-being of our employees with premium healthcare and accident insurance, as well as a wellness package to help you stay healthy and wealthy. SHA-2, SHA-3, HMAC; KDFs such as HKDF, PBKDF2, Argon2, scrypt. Awareness of ML-KEM (Kyber), ML-DSA (Dilithium), and post-quantum trends is a plus. title: Remote Senior DevOps Engineer
description: Top 3 Reasons To Join Us Gain very attractive salary and benefits; Be a developer, not a coder; Excellent environment and team to help you grow. The Job Projects you could work on Coding infrastructure automation with CDK, and Bitbucket Pipelines CI/CD; Improving our Elastic Monitoring or building new metrics; Helping release managers deploy and fix new versions of the various Repeat apps/microservices; Plan, prepare for, and execute the migration from Amazon EC2 virtual machines running on AWS to cloud-native container-based deployments with Amazon ECS; Develop a relationship with a product group, define their SLAs, share data on those SLAs and improve their reliability Responsibilities Run our infrastructure with AWS CDK, Bitbucket Pipelines CI/CD, and Kubernetes; Build monitoring that alerts on symptoms rather than on outages; Document every action so your findings turn into repeatable actions and then into automation; Improve operational processes (such as deployments and upgrades) to make them as boring as possible; Design, build and maintain core infrastructure that enables scaling to support hundreds of thousands of concurrent users; Debug production issues across services and levels of the stack; Plan the growth of the product’s infrastructure. Your Skills and Experience Think about systems: edge cases, failure modes, behaviors, specific implementations; Know your way around Linux and the Unix Shell; Know what configuration management systems like Chef and Ansible are used for; Strong programming skills in Shell, Typescript, and Python; Have good English communication skills; Have an urge to collaborate and communicate asynchronously; Have an urge to document all the things so you don’t need to learn the same thing twice; Have an enthusiastic, go-for-it attitude. When you see something broken, you can’t help but fix it; Have an urge to deliver quickly and effectively, and iterate fast; Share our values, and work in accordance with those values; Have experience with Apache/Nginx, HAProxy, Docker, Kubernetes, CDK, or similar technologies; Ability to use Bitbucket. Why You'll Love Working Here Remote work model; Full social insurance including probationary period; 12 days of annual leave and 3 additional special holidays (Swedish National Day, Christmas Eve & your Birthday); Annual leave increases with loyalty; Premium health care package for employees & family members; English, professional working environment.

title: Product Business Analyst
description: Top 3 Reasons To Join Us Đãi ngộ hấp dẫn, thu nhập phù hợp năng lực Môi trường TRẺ chuyên nghiệp, sáng tạo,cạnh tranh Được đào tạo nâng cao năng lực The Job Phân tích nghiệp vụ & Thiết kế sản phẩm 1. Khảo sát nghiệp vụ end-to-end: làm việc với các bộ phận (cửa hàng, kho/DC, mua hàng, giao nhận, Ecom, kế toán…) và đi thực tế tại cửa hàng/kho; phân tích ngược từ yêu cầu để tìm ra điểm vướng và nhu cầu thật, thay vì chỉ xử lý từng yêu cầu nhỏ, tức thời. 2. Đề xuất giải pháp và đánh giá ảnh hưởng: tối ưu cả sản phẩm lẫn quy trình nghiệp vụ, ưu tiên tự động hóa thao tác thủ công; đánh giá ảnh hưởng lên toàn quy trình và các bộ phận liên quan, báo người chịu trách nhiệm quy trình (process owner) để điều chỉnh vận hành phù hợp; cùng người dùng chuẩn hóa quy trình để dễ kiểm soát. 3. Thiết kế giải pháp: dựng luồng sử dụng, khung giao diện (wireframe), bản mẫu (mockup/prototype) để người dùng dễ hình dung, ưu tiên đơn giản, thao tác nhanh; tích hợp sẵn cơ chế hạn chế sai sót do con người (kiểm tra dữ liệu nhập, cảnh báo, phân quyền, phê duyệt, lưu vết thao tác) và cấu hình/tham số linh hoạt để dễ mở rộng khi mô hình kinh doanh thay đổi mà hạn chế phải lập trình lại. 4. Chạy thử và chốt phương án: trình bày thiết kế, cho người dùng chạy thử quy trình trên bản mẫu để góp ý, điều chỉnh; thống nhất phạm vi với người dùng và đội nhóm trước khi phát triển. 5. Xác định KPI và thứ tự ưu tiên: đặt mục tiêu, chỉ số đo lường cho từng tính năng; đề xuất thứ tự ưu tiên dựa trên giá trị mang lại cho mục tiêu kinh doanh và chốt với quản lý trực tiếp. 6. Viết tài liệu yêu cầu đầy đủ: user story, điều kiện nghiệm thu, tình huống nghiệp vụ, trường hợp ngoại lệ, quy tắc kiểm tra dữ liệu đầu vào (validation); phối hợp đội lập trình thiết kế luồng tích hợp, đồng bộ dữ liệu với ERP, Ecom, logistics (luồng dữ liệu, ánh xạ trường thông tin). 7. Bàn giao cho Dev/QC: trình bày user story với đội lập trình (Dev) và kiểm thử (QC) để làm rõ yêu cầu, thống nhất cách hiểu trước khi thực hiện. Triển khai và cải tiến 8. Đồng hành cùng đội phát triển: giải đáp nghiệp vụ cho đội lập trình (Dev) và kiểm thử (QC) trong quá trình phát triển; tham gia nghiệm thu (UAT) cùng người dùng trước khi đưa vào vận hành. 9. Đưa tính năng vào sử dụng: chuẩn bị tài liệu hướng dẫn, đào tạo người dùng và hỗ trợ xử lý vướng mắc trong giai đoạn đầu vận hành. 10. Đo lường và cải tiến: sau khi ra mắt, theo dõi mức độ sử dụng và hiệu quả tính năng so với KPI đã đặt; thu thập phản hồi người dùng để đề xuất cải tiến tiếp theo. 11. Ứng dụng AI vào công việc: chủ động dùng công cụ AI (Claude, ChatGPT/Codex, Gemini…) để rút ngắn thời gian phân tích, viết tài liệu, dựng bản mẫu và rà soát yêu cầu. Your Skills and Experience Kinh nghiệm & kiến thức 1. Từ 4 năm kinh nghiệm ở vị trí BA, Product Owner, Functional Consultant hoặc tương đương trong lĩnh vực phần mềm, ưu tiên có kinh nghiệm trong mảng bán lẻ (retail), thương mại điện tử (ecommerce), logistics. 2. Có kinh nghiệm làm việc liên phòng ban (cross-team), điều phối và kết nối các bộ phận để thống nhất yêu cầu, phạm vi và tiến độ. 3. Đã làm việc theo mô hình Agile/Scrum; sử dụng thành thạo Jira, Confluence hoặc công cụ tương đương. 4. Ưu tiên (không bắt buộc): có hiểu biết về hệ thống ERP và cách vận hành của công ty bán lẻ thực phẩm. 5. Hiểu cơ bản về cơ sở dữ liệu và API, đọc được tài liệu API và ánh xạ dữ liệu (data mapping) giữa các hệ thống để trao đổi được với đội lập trình. Kỹ năng chuyên môn 6. Tư duy logic tốt: phân tích được nghiệp vụ theo toàn bộ luồng end-to-end (full flow) qua các bộ phận liên quan và nhu cầu người dùng; biết vẽ sơ đồ luồng quy trình. 7. Mô tả được quy trình hiện tại (AS-IS), đề xuất quy trình cải tiến (TO-BE) và nhận diện được các bước có thể chuẩn hóa, tự động hóa. 8. Có tư duy UX tốt, thiết kế giao diện đơn giản, dễ thao tác; dựng được khung giao diện và bản mẫu rõ ràng bằng Figma hoặc công cụ tương đương (không yêu cầu kỹ năng đồ họa chuyên sâu). 9. Biết thiết kế cơ chế kiểm soát trong hệ thống (kiểm tra dữ liệu nhập, phân quyền, luồng phê duyệt, lưu vết) và thiết kế tính năng theo cấu hình/tham số để dễ mở rộng. 10. Viết được user story, điều kiện nghiệm thu (acceptance criteria) rõ ràng và lường trước các trường hợp ngoại lệ; viết tài liệu mạch lạc, giao tiếp và trình bày tốt, làm việc được với cả người dùng nghiệp vụ lẫn đội lập trình. 11. Tiếng Anh tốt cả 4 kỹ năng nghe, nói, đọc, viết để làm việc với đối tác nước ngoài. 12. Biết ứng dụng công cụ AI vào công việc hằng ngày và chia sẻ được ví dụ cụ thể. 13. Biết đặt KPI cho tính năng và tự truy vấn số liệu để theo dõi hiệu quả, rút ra nhận định; vận dụng được phương pháp xếp thứ tự ưu tiên Tư duy & thái độ 14. Luôn khao khát tạo ra những tính năng đơn giản, dễ sử dụng, giúp người dùng cải thiện hiệu suất làm việc; có tư duy tự động hóa các hoạt động vận hành lặp đi lặp lại và giảm thiểu sai sót do con người (human error). 15. Bình tĩnh giải quyết vấn đề phát sinh; luôn chủ động tìm hiểu các ảnh hưởng liên quan đến tính năng mình đang làm. 16. Chủ động học hỏi, cập nhật công nghệ mới; chịu được áp lực công việc để hoàn thành trách nhiệm được giao, luôn tìm cách cải tiến công việc để tăng năng suất và hiệu quả. 17. Sẵn sàng đi thực tế tại cửa hàng, kho; kiên nhẫn hướng dẫn và truyền đạt dễ hiểu cho người dùng không chuyên về công nghệ. Ưu tiên ứng viên Ứng viên chỉ cần đáp ứng một trong các tiêu chí sau (không bắt buộc đáp ứng tất cả): Đã tham gia dự án vận hành siêu thị: bán hàng, khuyến mãi, kiểm kê, quản lý cửa hàng… Đã tham gia dự án vận hành hàng hóa: từ nhà cung cấp về trung tâm phân phối (DC), từ DC về siêu thị. Đã làm việc với phân hệ kế toán trong ERP: công nợ, đối soát, hóa đơn… Có tài liệu phân tích hoặc sản phẩm thiết kế có thể chia sẻ (portfolio). Lưu ý: Ứng viên sử dụng laptop cá nhân khi làm việc. Why You'll Love Working Here Đóng bảo hiểm xã hội trên 100% mức lương. Làm việc 6 tiếng/ngày (9h–16h), tập trung năng suất để có thời gian hợp lý cho bản thân và gia đình. Chế độ nghỉ phép hấp dẫn: ngoài số ngày phép theo quy định của pháp luật, còn có phép thâm niên và phép nghỉ sinh nhật cho bản thân và người thân (vợ/chồng, con cái). Review tăng lương hàng năm

Có tư duy UX tốt, thiết kế giao diện đơn giản, dễ thao tác; dựng được khung giao diện và bản mẫu rõ ràng bằng Figma hoặc công cụ tương đương (không yêu cầu kỹ năng đồ họa chuyên sâu). 9. Biết thiết kế cơ chế kiểm soát trong hệ thống (kiểm tra dữ liệu nhập, phân quyền, luồng phê duyệt, lưu vết) và thiết kế tính năng theo cấu hình/tham số để dễ mở rộng. 10. Bình tĩnh giải quyết vấn đề phát sinh; luôn chủ động tìm hiểu các ảnh hưởng liên quan đến tính năng mình đang làm. 16. Sẵn sàng đi thực tế tại cửa hàng, kho; kiên nhẫn hướng dẫn và truyền đạt dễ hiểu cho người dùng không chuyên về công nghệ. description: Top 3 Reasons To Join Us - Full social, health & unemployment insurance Annual learning and training budget - 13th-month salary, Tet bonus, and project bonuse The Job GENERAL INFORMATION | THÔNG TIN CHUNG Position: QC/Tester Department: Quality Assurance (QA/QC) Report to: Tech Lead / Sub Lead Headcount: 2 Level: Mid-Senior JOB PURPOSE | MỤC TIÊU CÔNG VIỆC Đảm bảo chất lượng sản phẩm MDM trên đa nền tảng (Android, iOS, Web), phát hiện lỗi sớm trong quy trình phát triển, xây dựng và duy trì bộ test toàn diện cho tất cả tính năng MDM. Ensure the quality of MDM products across multiple platforms (Android, iOS, Web). Detect defects early in the development lifecycle and build/maintain a comprehensive test suite for all MDM features. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES | TRÁCH NHIỆM CHÍNH Xây dựng test plan và test cases chi tiết cho từng tính năng MDM (enrollment, policy, remote commands). Create detailed test plans and test cases for each MDM feature, including enrollment, policy, and remote commands. Thực hiện kiểm thử chức năng (functional testing) trên admin console và mobile agent. Perform functional testing on the Admin Console and Mobile Agent. Kiểm thử đa nền tảng: Android (nhiều phiên bản, nhiều hãng), iOS, web browsers. Execute testing across multiple platforms, including various Android versions/manufacturers, iOS, and web browsers. Kiểm thử hiệu năng: số lượng thiết bị đồng thời, response time, battery consumption. Validate performance metrics such as device concurrency, response time, and battery consumption. Kiểm thử bảo mật cơ bản: authentication, authorization, data encryption. Conduct basic security testing covering authentication, authorization, and data encryption. Thực hiện regression testing trước mỗi release, quản lý bug lifecycle trên Jira. Perform regression testing before each release and manage the bug lifecycle using Jira. Xây dựng automation test cho các luồng chính (API testing, UI automation). Develop automation tests for core workflows, including API and UI automation. Kỹ năng kỹ thuật | Technical Skills Testing Methodologies: black-box, white-box, regression, smoke, UAT. Automation: Selenium, Appium, or Detox cho mobile testing. API testing: Postman, REST Assured. Performance testing: JMeter, k6, or equivalent tools. Bug tracking: Jira, with strong skills in writing clear bug reports. 4. Kỹ năng mềm | Soft Skills Tỉ mỉ, cẩn thận, tư duy phân tích edge cases. Meticulous, careful, and possessing an analytical mindset for edge cases. Kiên nhẫn, kiểm thử lặp đi lặp lại. Patient and comfortable with repetitive testing tasks. Giao tiếp rõ ràng khi báo cáo bugs cho developers. Clear communication skills for reporting bugs to developers. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs) | KPI ĐO LƯỜNG HIỆU QUẢ 1. Test coverage ≥ 90% cho tất cả user stories. Test coverage ≥ 90% for all user stories. 2. Tỷ lệ bugs phát hiện trước release / tổng bugs ≥ 85%. Defect Detection Rate (Bugs found before release / Total bugs) ≥ 85%. 3. Thời gian verify fix ≤ 4 giờ sau khi dev fix xong. Fix verification time ≤ 4 hours after developer completion. 4. Automation test coverage cho core flows ≥ 60%. Automation test coverage for core flows ≥ 60%. 5. Số bugs escape (lọt qua QC lên production) < 3/release. Bug escape rate: (leaked to production) < 3 per release. TOOLSTACK | CÔNG CỤ SỬ DỤNG Jira — Bug tracking, test management. Postman — API testing. BrowserStack — Cross-platform mobile testing. title: Technical Product Manager
description: Top 3 Reasons To Join Us Personal Development Opportunities Attractive Salary & Seniority Bonus (3/5/7 years) Premium Private Health Care(employee & dependents) The Job As Technical Product Manager, you keep the stream focused on outcomes that matter for customers, partners and the business. You take charge of product and technology direction within the stream, and you make sure that what we build is actually used and actually creates value. You will be the regular technical contact for customers and partners, the person who carries their reality into the stream and carries the stream's direction back out. This is a bridge role that holds real weight. You’ll work shoulder to shoulder with our Product Managers to align product vision, value, and technology in the stream backlog, and you’ll be a full member of the stream. Here, leadership means clarity: every initiative has a clear, measurable and traceable outcome. The team's autonomy is built on the confidence that they are doing the right thing under the supervision of the Technical Product Manager. WHAT WILL YOU DO? Shape the direction Set product and technology direction for the stream, giving every initiative a clear target outcome. Explore new technical possibilities, including through agentic research, and bring concrete options to the team. Frame hard technical questions, explore options and steer the team toward sound decisions. Co-own the stream backlog with the PMs. Keep it shaped, prioritized and connected to outcomes, with the customer and partner view always present. Build and run it Shape features and write technical specifications, using AI-assisted techniques to turn problems into clear, buildable plans. Implement features end to end across the relevant layer of the stack, following Magnolia’s development policies and quality standards. Live the “you build it, you run it, you take charge” mindset as a regular member of the stream. Run our product solutions together with the platform, cloud and support teams. Be the voice of the customer Act as the technical contact for customers and partners. Understand their context and turn it into product direction. Handle 3rd level support topics and communication, sometimes working directly with customers. Take part in PD on-call duties in an advisory role, with a focus on on-premise installations. Drive adoption and impact Track whether features are used and create value, and act when they don’t. Enable go-to-market so features reach customers and partners well, including internal enablement and training. Work across streams and departments, such as support, training, customer success, professional services and cloud, to keep direction and delivery connected. Collaborate proactively and constructively with your team, your department and the wider company. Your Skills and Experience Must-Have Qualifications Strong critical thinking, a collaborative spirit and a take-charge mentality. Clear communication skills and the ability to work well with colleagues and with internal and external stakeholders. Ability to enable and train technical people on your own topics. Solid technical system design and solution thinking. Experience in technical shaping and specification of product solutions using agentic flows. Hands-on engineering skills across frontend (REACT, Typescript, node.js), backend (J2EE, micro services) and platform (Cloud and Container based environments). A strong quality mindset, with experience in unit, integration, performance and platform testing. Leadership skills without formal authority, guiding through influence and clarity. Full accountability for your own work and solutions. Competencies in secure development, threat modelling, vulnerability handling, data protection and related standards (e.g. ISO 27001, SOC 2). Proficient English, written and spoken. SO, WHO ARE WE? Bright, fun, and open-minded colleagues spread across the globe Lateral and vertical growth opportunities Flexible, innovative and outcome-oriented Aside from work, we are parents, gamers, bookworms, athletes, adrenaline junkies, philosophers, and so much more. WE ARE FOR YOU IF YOU LIKE TO… take charge : Everyone at Magnolia is in the driver’s seat and we set the direction according to what our customers, colleagues and culture need. No matter the roadblocks you see ahead, you take charge in (re)shaping the destination. connect : You never drive alone. Building meaningful connections means creating experiences together that form a foundation of trust so next time there’s a bump in the road, you know someone else has your back be you : Choose your own ways and means. We thrive on making every perspective count so that you feel safe enough to follow your purpose and at the same time pursue one common goal. Our way of growing is to mutually question ourselves and others. Why You'll Love Working Here Personal Development Opportunities: We believe in nurturing individual growth and happiness. As part of our commitment, we provide a range of indoor and outdoor training activities, including technical courses, English classes, and soft skills training. Comprehensive Health Coverage: Your well-being and that of your family are paramount to us. We cover 100% of healthcare premiums for all employees and their dependents, ensuring you can access quality medical care without financial worries. Employee and Family Care: At Magnolia, we extend our care beyond the workplace. From health insurance to organizing summer vacations and family events like Family Day, Children's Day, and the Mid-Autumn Festival, we prioritize the well-being and happiness of our employees and their families. Additionally, enjoy recreational activities such as football, swimming, bowling, cinema, and more. Competitive Salary and Benefits: Your hard work deserves recognition. Our compensation package includes: An attractive salary, a 13th-month salary, seniority bonuses, and opportunities for career advancement. Annual leave of up to 21 days; Regular exchange programs to Switzerland for two weeks, twice a year. Flexible Working Hours: We understand the importance of work-life balance. Enjoy flexibility in your schedule. Employee Perks: Your comfort and satisfaction matter to us. Our office is stocked with beverages, fruits, and snacks, and we provide meals every evening. Join us on "Whoopee Fridays" for team-building activities, knowledge exchange sessions, and lively conversations.

description: Top 3 Reasons To Join Us Competitive Salary & internal shares program Annual allowances for personal development & sport 20 days annual leave & 5 days sick leave The Job Why do we create this position? Infrastructure and hosting are vital to GeoComply’s success, ensuring uninterrupted, top-tier service for the US gaming industry. Beyond that, we engineer forward-thinking infrastructure to deliver high availability, key to our uptime, making it easy to scale, accelerating innovation, and keeping pace with industry growth and evolving customer demands. We are an engineering organization navigating a critical migration and innovation phase. Our goal is to reduce cloud platform dependency, optimize costs, and ensure high availability and scalability by migrating service workloads from AWS to GCP. At the same time, we’re modernizing our systems, shifting from a monolithic architecture to microservices, and building a resilient, multi-region platform. To sustain this pace, we are growing our DevOps capability in Vietnam. This role adds senior hands-on execution capacity to the team. We are looking for someone who can own significant workstreams end to end, mentor the engineers around them, and partner directly with development squads as we scale. Job Description As a Senior DevOps Engineer based in Vietnam and part of a global DevOps team, you'll design, build, and operate the infrastructure and DevOps tooling that powers GeoComply's systems. You'll own meaningful pieces of our AWS to GCP migration and multi-region platform on GCP, contributing to a unified, scalable core infrastructure that enables product development teams to deliver value quickly and keep pace with our customers' growing and fast-changing demands. This means shifting DevOps from "Serve" to "Enable" through self-service tooling, without loosening security, standards, or guardrails. You'll help ensure the platform runs reliably 24/7 and holds up under peak events like the Super Bowl, consult product teams on cloud-native best practices, work independently on complex problems, and use AI assistance as a standard part of how you build and operate. Multi-Region Architecture: Implement and operate multi-region infrastructure across AWS and GCP for low-latency traffic management (shadowing, shifting) and disaster recovery, in partnership with development and data teams. Modernization & System Design: Support the transition from monoliths to microservices and align infrastructure with evolving application needs, promoting automation, scalability, and maintainability. Security & Compliance: Embed security best practices across the infrastructure (IAM, least privilege, secrets management, network policies, data protection) and ensure compliance with industry standards and internal governance. Engineering Platform & Operational Excellence: Improve CI/CD, observability (e.g. LGTM stack, GCP Monitoring), SLIs/SLOs, on-call and incident response, and post-mortems that reach systemic root cause; build reusable patterns and self-service tooling that shift DevOps from "Serve" to "Enable." Knowledge Sharing & Mentorship: Mentor teammates through code and architecture reviews, and support development teams via reusable patterns, documentation, and self-service capabilities rather than by fielding their questions directly. AI-Assisted Engineering: Leverage GenAI tools and AI agents to accelerate common development and operational work so your time goes to the highest-impact engineering, reviewing and verifying output against production standards for reliability, security, cost, and maintainability, and coach teammates to do the same. Your Skills and Experience 5+ years in DevOps, cloud infrastructure, SRE, or platform engineering, with demonstrated experience taking medium-to-large infrastructure projects. Strong analytical mindset to define complex problems, evaluate technical trade-offs, and independently navigate ambiguity to drive cross-system solutions to completion. Production expertise with containerization especially in Kubernetes environment, including deep familiarity with cluster lifecycle management, scaling strategies, resource optimization, and troubleshooting cluster and workload issues. Proven experience designing modular Infrastructure as Code (e.g. Terraform) and building secure, automated CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions). Proven track record of architecting and operating production environments on GCP and/or AWS, specifically leveraging managed services (e.g. GKE/EKS, Cloud SQL/RDS, Pub/Sub/SQS). Experience with multi-cloud/multi-region is a plus. Direct ownership of highly available systems, including on-call, incident response, and post-incident improvement. Proven experience with pillars of telemetry (metrics, logs, traces) and modern observability stacks (e.g LGTM stack, Datadog). Practical experience with SRE concepts and managing cardinality, retention, and cost at scale. Familiar and hands-on practice using AI coding assistants and agentic tools (e.g. Claude Code, OpenCode) on real DevOps work (IaC, debugging, incident triage, post-mortems). Communication: Professional working proficiency in English, written and verbal. Must be able to explain technical decisions clearly in English, in writing, in design documents, and in live discussion. Bonus Points Experience operating Service Mesh solutions (e.g. Istio, Linkerd) in complex microservices environments. Around 2,500 specialized workstations. One healthcare company being born. A global healthcare leader is looking for a Senior IT Systems Engineer in Vietnam to become a cornerstone of its IT. You will keep the systems running that labs, production lines and quality teams cannot work without, from instruments to GxP applications to legacy machines. As a versatile generalist, you will troubleshoot across Windows, identity, endpoint security, monitoring and backup, and lead the way when incidents strike. You will start as a fully integrated member of an established global team. Over the next 18 months you will master the environment and earn the trust of the people who depend on it. Then the organization separates and you step up to carry the core independently, with a clear pathway to technical lead. Spin-offs like this come once in a career. What you’ll be doing Own the estate: Keep ~2,500 workstations healthy and secure: OS lifecycles, patching, endpoint tools, backups and monitoring. When you coordinate a change, people listen. Master the environment (first 18 months): Work side by side with an established global team. Learn every quirk, build real relationships with lab and manufacturing colleagues, and take ownership early. Lead when it matters: Run complex incident investigations, drive containment and recovery, and fix root causes so problems never come back. Keep it compliant: Find and fix non-compliant or unmonitored devices, validate assets, remediate remotely and support audits with confidence. Tame the unusual: Support lab instruments, manufacturing systems, GxP applications and legacy hardware that most engineers never touch. Automate and improve: Script away repetitive checks and remediation, cut technical debt and make diagnostics faster for everyone. Share what you know: Write the runbooks, procedures and recovery guides that become the new organization’s playbook, and train others on them. Step into the lead role: Once the organization separates, carry the core of the environment independently and grow with it into technical leadership. Your Skills and Experience Skills Exceptional English & Communication: Highly proficient spoken and written English. You explain complex risks and solutions clearly to non-technical stakeholders and global management. Pharmaceutical Background: Experience in pharmaceutical, life-sciences or clinical lab environments. Generalist IT & Windows Management: Strong, broad enterprise Windows experience, including Active Directory, GPO, PowerShell, patching, software distribution and backup tools. Endpoint Security: Solid understanding of endpoint security controls and privileged access. Observability & Backup: Knowledge of enterprise backup, CMDB and monitoring systems. Infrastructure Troubleshooting: You follow a problem across OS, applications, networking, identity and hardware until you find the cause. Controlled Processes: Experience with formal change management and technical documentation. Production & Incident Support: A proven record supporting production environments and handling major incidents Nice To Have Experience in GxP, or validated systems. Familiarity with legacy Windows systems, PowerShell automation, domain migrations, vendor management, or setting up new support services. Soft skills Ownership: You take end-to-end accountability and see issues through to the end. Communication: You are a bridge between technical teams and the business people who rely on them. Technical Judgment: You balance business continuity, risk and urgency across system boundaries. Problem Solving: You know a quick workaround from a real fix, and you deliver both. Adaptability: Legacy equipment, ambiguity and specialized environments interest you rather than worry you. Resilience: You stay calm and document clearly when the pressure is on. Growth Mindset: You want to help build a company, not just work in one. title: Chuyên viên dữ liệu (Data engineer
description: Top 3 Reasons To Join Us The Job Xây dựng và phát triển kho dữ liệu của Công ty theo kiến trúc chuẩn Kho Dữ liệu Xây dựng và chuẩn hóa các vùng dữ liệu phục vụ công tác khai thác của MBAMC bằng ML, AI… Xử lý các add-hoc về insight dữ liệu hỗ trợ hoạt động kinh doanh, quản trị Nghiên cứu, đề xuất và triển khai các công nghệ mới về dữ liệu (Machine learning, AI…) Your Skills and Experience Đại học Ưu tiên kinh nghiệm làm kho dữ liệu (data warehouse, datalake) Why You'll Love Working Here Với phương châm coi nguồn nhân lực là yếu tố quyết định sự thành công của Công ty, MBAMC luôn chú trọng đến việc phát triển năng lực, chăm lo cho đời sống vật chất, tinh thần của CBNV. Chúng tôi hướng đến chính sách đãi ngộ cạnh tranh: “Nhân sự tốt nhất, trả lương cao nhất”, tạo mọi điều kiện thuận lợi để CBNV yên tâm công tác, cống hiến. Bên cạnh đó, MBAMC cam kết đảm bảo các chế độ của người lao động theo quy định của pháp luật, tuân thủ các chính sách của nhà nước. Cùng với lộ trình thăng tiến và định hướng công việc rõ ràng, MBAMC cũng thường xuyên triển khai các chương trình đào tạo nhằm nâng cao kiến thức chuyên môn, kỹ năng làm việc. Nằm trong định hướng phát triển bền vững, lâu dài, liên tục tạo ra nguồn sinh khí mới cho mọi lĩnh vực hoạt động, MBAMC không ngừng tìm kiếm và thu hút nhân tài có mong muốn gắn bó với Công ty. Các đãi ngộ tại MBAMC: - Lương Chức danh; - Lương hiệu quả công việc; - Lương tháng 13; - Phụ cấp; - Chế độ xem xét tăng lương gắn liền với hiệu quả công việc. - Thưởng nhân các ngày lễ tết và các sự kiện MBAMC; - Thưởng thành tích định kỳ và đột xuất cho cá nhân hoặc tập thể; - Thưởng sáng kiến cải tiến kỹ thuật, nâng cao hiệu quả hoạt động kinh doanh. - Bảo hiểm Xã hội, Y tế, Thất nghiệp theo quy định của nhà nước; - Gói bảo hiểm sức khoẻ của MIC dành riêng cho CBNV Công ty; - Bảo hiểm tai nạn lao động. - Trợ cấp nhân các sự kiện đặc biệt của CBNV; - Trợ cấp trang phục; - Chương trình du lịch trong và ngoài nước hàng năm; - Khám sức khỏe định kỳ; - Các hoạt động văn hóa, văn nghệ, thể thao dành cho CBNV; - Các chương trình chăm lo đời sống và gia đình CBNV: ngày hội gia đình, hỗ trợ đào tạo, khen thưởng con CBNV có thành tích học tập tốt; Thăm hỏi tứ thân phụ mẫu, ốm đau, hiếu hỷ .... - Làm việc từ thứ 2 và thứ 6, 08h00 đến 17h30 (nghỉ trưa 90 phút, Có nhà ăn phục vụ CBNV); - Thời gian nghỉ chế độ và nghỉ lễ theo quy định Công ty và quy định Pháp luật.

title: Junior Game Designer
description: Top 3 Reasons To Join Us The Job Hiện tại chúng tôi đang tìm kiếm một Game Designer (Junior) để phụ trách: Thiết kế, cấu hình và hoàn thiện các màn chơi cho dòng game mobile puzzle bằng các mechanic và công cụ hiện có. Xây dựng bố cục, mục tiêu, điều kiện thắng/thua, số bước, blocker, hint và các thông số của màn chơi dựa trên learning curve và interest curve của sản phẩm. Theo dõi phản hồi của người chơi và các chỉ số như tỷ lệ hoàn thành, số lượt thử, thời gian hoàn thành, tỷ lệ bỏ cuộc và mức độ sử dụng hint/booster để phát hiện vấn đề. Đề xuất, triển khai và đánh giá các phương án tối ưu level dựa trên kết quả playtest, phản hồi người chơi và dữ liệu sau phát hành. Xây dựng và cập nhật level specification, balancing sheet cùng các tài liệu thiết kế, bao gồm mục tiêu, flow, luật chơi, thông số, hint, fail condition và các trường hợp đặc biệt. Phối hợp với Lead Game Designer, Dev, Art, QA và PO/PM để đảm bảo màn chơi được triển khai đúng thiết kế và đạt chất lượng trước khi phát hành. Sau khi nắm vững hệ thống level, từng bước tham gia nghiên cứu mechanic mới, cải thiện game feel và xây dựng nội dung LiveOps dưới sự hướng dẫn của Lead Game Designer. Your Skills and Experience Kiến thức và kinh nghiệm Có ít nhất 1 năm kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực Game Design, ưu tiên ứng viên đã tham gia phát triển game puzzle. Hiểu và có khả năng vận dụng Learning Curve, Interest Curve cùng các yếu tố cấu thành độ khó trong quá trình thiết kế và cân bằng màn chơi. Hiểu các nguyên tắc cơ bản của game design, bao gồm core gameplay loop, progression, balancing, reward và động lực của người chơi. Có khả năng phân tích cấu trúc một màn chơi, xác định nguyên nhân gây khó, gây nhàm chán hoặc khiến người chơi bỏ cuộc. Có khả năng viết tài liệu thiết kế và mô tả yêu cầu một cách rõ ràng, logic, đủ chi tiết để các bộ phận liên quan triển khai. Có khả năng sử dụng Unity, level editor hoặc các công cụ cấu hình nội dung game. Kỹ năng và tư duy Có tư duy logic, hệ thống và khả năng giải quyết vấn đề. Có khả năng playtest, quan sát trải nghiệm người chơi, tiếp nhận phản hồi và liên tục điều chỉnh thiết kế. Tỉ mỉ, kiên nhẫn và có khả năng duy trì chất lượng khi làm việc với số lượng level lớn. Có khả năng giao tiếp, phối hợp và trao đổi công việc hiệu quả với Dev, Art, QA và PO/PM. Có tinh thần chủ động học hỏi, sẵn sàng tiếp nhận phản hồi và cải thiện thiết kế qua nhiều vòng review. Điểm cộng Thường xuyên chơi và có khả năng phân tích các game mobile puzzle. Có kinh nghiệm đọc và phân tích các chỉ số như completion rate, fail rate, number of attempts, completion time, drop-off và hint/booster usage. Có hiểu biết cơ bản về tutorial, onboarding, game feel, LiveOps hoặc A/B testing. Có portfolio bao gồm level design, balancing sheet, game design document, prototype hoặc bài phân tích game.
